text: Si Men hollii ma an Annabiijo, yogo ko Men fodi ɓe e lepte ado maayde maa nden, ɗum ko fewjoore Amen. Si taw non Men ƴettitii ma ado Men hollude ma ɗum, haray huunde fawaaki ma si wanaa yottin- gol ko Men yamir-maa yottingol kon. Wanaa an jogi yoɓitugol ɓe maa hasbugol ɓe, ɗum ko e Juuɗe Amen woni.
